Priya Patel
Data Scientist | Machine Learning Engineer

Contact:
Email: priya.patel@dataml.com
Phone: +1-555-0789
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/priyapatel-ml
GitHub: https://github.com/priya-ml
Location: Austin, TX

Professional Summary:
Data Scientist with 4+ years of experience building machine learning models and data pipelines. Expertise in Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and cloud-based ML platforms. Passionate about turning data into actionable insights and deploying production-grade ML systems.

Work Experience:

Senior Data Scientist | AI Innovations Labs
Austin, TX | July 2022 - Present
- Developed recommendation system increasing user engagement by 45%
- Built NLP models for sentiment analysis processing 1M+ reviews daily
- Implemented MLOps pipeline for automated model training and deployment
- Designed A/B testing framework for model evaluation
- Reduced model inference time by 60% through optimization and quantization
- Tech Stack: Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, AWS SageMaker, MLflow

Data Scientist | FinTech Solutions
Austin, TX | August 2020 - June 2022
- Created fraud detection model with 98% accuracy reducing fraud losses by $2M annually
- Built credit risk assessment models using ensemble methods
- Developed time series forecasting models for financial predictions
- Implemented feature engineering pipeline processing 100GB+ data daily
- Collaborated with engineering team to deploy models in production
- Tech Stack: Python, XGBoost, LightGBM, Pandas, Spark, PostgreSQL, Docker

Junior Data Analyst | Data Insights Corp.
New York, NY | June 2019 - July 2020
- Performed exploratory data analysis on customer behavior data
- Created dashboards and visualizations using Tableau and Power BI
- Built predictive models for customer churn
- Automated reporting processes using Python scripts
- Tech Stack: Python, SQL, Tableau, Excel, Jupyter

Education:

Master of Science in Data Science
University of Texas at Austin | 2017-2019
GPA: 3.9/4.0
Thesis: "Deep Learning Approaches for Natural Language Understanding"

Bachelor of Science in Mathematics
MIT | 2013-2017
GPA: 3.8/4.0

Technical Skills:
- Programming: Python, R, SQL, Scala
- ML Frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM
- Data Processing: Pandas, NumPy, Spark, Dask
- Cloud & MLOps: AWS (SageMaker, Lambda, S3), GCP, MLflow, Kubeflow, DVC
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis
- Visualization: Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, Tableau, Power BI
- Tools: Jupyter, Git, Docker, Airflow
- Specializations: NLP, Computer Vision, Time Series, Recommender Systems

Key Projects:

1. Customer Recommendation Engine (2023)
   - Built personalized recommendation system using collaborative filtering
   - Implemented deep learning models (Neural Collaborative Filtering)
   - Technologies: PyTorch, AWS SageMaker, Redis, FastAPI
   - Result: Increased customer engagement by 45% and revenue by $3M

2. Real-Time Fraud Detection System (2021)
   - Developed ensemble model combining gradient boosting and neural networks
   - Implemented real-time scoring API with sub-100ms latency
   - Technologies: XGBoost, TensorFlow, Flask, Redis, PostgreSQL
   - Result: Detected 98% of fraudulent transactions, saved $2M annually

3. NLP Sentiment Analysis Platform (2023)
   - Created multi-language sentiment analysis using transformer models
   - Processed customer reviews, social media, and support tickets
   - Technologies: BERT, Hugging Face Transformers, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB
   - Result: Automated sentiment tracking for 1M+ texts daily

4. Predictive Maintenance System (2022)
   - Built time series forecasting model for equipment failure prediction
   - Implemented anomaly detection using autoencoders
   - Technologies: LSTM, Prophet, Pandas, Airflow, PostgreSQL
   - Result: Reduced equipment downtime by 40%

Publications & Presentations:
- "Deep Learning for Financial Fraud Detection" - IEEE Conference 2022
- "Scaling ML Systems in Production" - MLOps Summit 2023
- Published 5 technical blog posts on Medium (50K+ views)

Certifications:
- AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty (2023)
- TensorFlow Developer Certificate (2022)
- Google Cloud Professional ML Engineer (2023)

Achievements:
- Kaggle Competition: Top 5% in Credit Risk Modeling Challenge
- Patent pending: "Novel Approach to Real-Time Fraud Detection"
- Mentored 2 junior data scientists
- Open source contributor to Scikit-learn and Pandas
